title: The Founder Lottery

sourceEvidence.excerpt: power-law distribution of outcomes: a small minority capture exceptional rewards, while many competent founders absorb financial loss, opportunity cost, psychological strain, and years of invisible work. Skill matters, but so do timing, inherited resources, networks, market position, and chance. The argument is not that entrepreneurship is irrational or that founders create no social value.
